name: spider_motionbricks
contract: MODEL_CONTRACT.md (shared creature contract of the dog model v2) + 'orient' (body frame joints); no 'seam' block
layout: pose = J*3 local joint positions (heading frame, root xz = 0, metres) + J*3 velocities + C contacts; root = [vx side, vz forward, yaw rate, root height]

contact.note: channels offset..offset+count of the DENORMALIZED decoder output; > threshold = the foot is planted

root_net.inputs: cmd [1,3] normalized like root values (side, forward, yaw rate); root_hist [1,4,4] normalized; ctx [1,4,D] normalized
root_net.output: root [1,28,4] normalized: the root values of the plan frames 4..31
